method: Each stock Portal ran from a fresh archive with its own compiled development themes and browser dependencies. The only tracked-path overlay was the same record blob. Opening screenshots use normal motion after fonts and button entrance animations settled. Reduced-motion counts use pixel samples at the renderer’s expected square centers, with empty day slots as negative controls.

images.title: Phone before the repair
images.caption: The 459-item record loads, but the original renderer cannot fit a strip under the buttons.

images.title: Phone during normal replay
images.caption: The operating strip and replay caption appear below both buttons without moving the statement.

images.title: Phone with reduced motion
images.caption: All 459 merged pull requests are visible in seven day columns. The caption fits within the opening screen.

images.title: Desktop during normal replay
images.caption: The original desktop table retains the ten maintainers, Contributors and the merge seat.

images.title: Shorter phone after scrolling
images.caption: At 375 × 812 the strip starts below the opening screen. A 100 px scroll reveals all 459 squares and the caption.
